title: VS Code bundled CLI versions govern hook delivery
summary: Claude Code and Codex VS Code sessions qualify for hook delivery using the version reported by the newest installed extension's bundled CLI. The probe checks the local and remote VS Code extension roots on the host running the hook. A later hook can fill an unknown session version once the relay observes the bundle. Codex floor checks use the CLI prerelease version for numbered builds, while session identity reports the complete bundled version. Native Windows delivery proof is pending.
